Notch+ uses the mediaremote-adapter by Jonas van den Berg (https://github.com/ungive/mediaremote-adapter) to read what is playing on this Mac.
Files: Vendor/mediaremote-adapter.pl and Vendor/MediaRemoteAdapter.framework.
License: BSD 3-Clause. Copyright (c) 2025 Jonas van den Berg. Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted provided that the copyright notice, this list of conditions and the disclaimer in the BSD 3-Clause License are retained.


Notch+ adapts the drag card and the System Settings window tracking of PermissionFlow (https://github.com/jaywcjlove/PermissionFlow) in Sources/System/AccessGuide.swift.
